entries.name: M5Stack Unit Light U021
entries.view: Photoresistor and adjustable LM393 light-threshold module. J1.1 is analog A.OUT, J1.2 is digital D.OUT, and the internal HT7533 regulator supplies the sensing circuit at 3.3 V. The schematic title and enclosure identify U021 despite the U201 download filename. Front housing view and a separate enlarged J1 socket mating face, rear-label side up. Socket contacts run white, yellow, red, black from left to right in that view. J1 terminal numbers follow the linked schematic. Housing shape and contact placement are representative; use manufacturer housing CAD for mechanical design.

contacts.label: A.OUT
contacts.description: Analog photoresistor-divider output, referenced to the internal 3.3 V rail. J1.1, white wire.

contacts.label: D.OUT
contacts.description: LM393 comparator output with onboard 10 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V; threshold set by the trimmer. J1.2, yellow wire.

contacts.label: 5V
contacts.description: 5 V supply input; not a GPIO. J1.3, red wire.

contacts.label: GND
contacts.description: Common supply and signal ground. J1.4, black wire.

entries.footprintNote: Reference off-board cable-termination carrier for M5Stack Unit Light U021. J1 and J2 rows use selected 2.54 mm pitch, 1 mm holes and 1.8 mm copper; this is not the enclosed Unit PCB or its connector mating pattern. J2 is the removable relay terminal when present. The housing illustration and generated WRL body are approximate. The linked manufacturer STL describes the housing; it is not imported by the WRL exporter.

entries.name: M5Stack Unit PIR U004
entries.view: AS312 passive infrared motion detector with a nominal two-second retriggerable output. The white-wire J1.1 is the motion output; yellow-wire J1.2 is unused. Housing IN/OUT captions describe the host port direction. Front housing view and a separate enlarged J1 socket mating face, rear-label side up. Socket contacts run white, yellow, red, black from left to right in that view. J1 terminal numbers follow the linked schematic. Housing shape and contact placement are representative; use manufacturer housing CAD for mechanical design.

contacts.label: OUT
contacts.description: Active-high motion output through a 1 kΩ series resistor from the 3.3 V AS312 sensor. J1.1, white wire.

contacts.label: NC
contacts.description: Unused yellow-wire contact in this schematic revision. J1.2, yellow wire.

contacts.label: 5V
contacts.description: 5 V supply input; not a GPIO. J1.3, red wire.

contacts.label: GND
contacts.description: Common supply and signal ground. J1.4, black wire.

entries.name: M5Stack Unit Relay U023
entries.view: 5 V single-channel SPDT relay module with S8050 transistor driver and flyback diode. J1.2 drives the coil, while J1.1 is unused. COM, NO and NC are isolated switching contacts and are not connected to Grove ground. Connector and housing placement follow the product photo. Front housing view and a separate enlarged J1 socket mating face, rear-label side up. Socket contacts run white, yellow, red, black from left to right in that view. J1 terminal numbers follow the linked schematic. Housing shape and contact placement are representative; use manufacturer housing CAD for mechanical design.

contacts.label: NC
contacts.description: Unused white-wire contact; not the relay normally-closed contact. J1.1, white wire.

contacts.label: DIN
contacts.description: Active-high transistor-driver input. A 10 kΩ resistor pulls the control line down. J1.2, yellow wire.

contacts.label: 5V
contacts.description: 5 V supply input; not a GPIO. J1.3, red wire.

contacts.label: GND
contacts.description: Common supply and signal ground. J1.4, black wire.

contacts.label: COM
contacts.description: Isolated relay common contact.

contacts.label: NO
contacts.description: Normally open relay contact; joins COM when the coil is energized.

contacts.label: NC
contacts.description: Normally closed relay contact; joins COM when the coil is de-energized.

entries.name: MIKROE BUZZ Click MIKROE-945
entries.view: Piezo transducer driven through a BC846 transistor. Both GPI and PWM reach the same driver node through populated J3/J2 links by default; do not drive them to opposite levels. Removing the corresponding link separates an input. J1 selects 3.3 V or 5 V supply. Component-side view with the bottom-right orientation notch. All sixteen mikroBUS header contacts are present, including the printed NC terminals. Header numbering follows the manufacturer pinout table: 1–8 down the left and 16–9 down the right. Small component shapes are representative.

entries.name: MIKROE Light Click MIKROE-1424
entries.view: PD15-22C/TR8 photodiode, LM358 amplifier and MCP3201 read-only SPI ADC. A/D SEL routes the amplifier either to AN or to the ADC; ADC is the documented default. I/O Level selects 3.3 V or 5 V for the SPI circuit. The AN pad is not an active output while the ADC path is selected. Component-side view with the bottom-right orientation notch. All sixteen mikroBUS header contacts are present, including the printed NC terminals. Header numbering follows the manufacturer pinout table: 1–8 down the left and 16–9 down the right. Small component shapes are representative.

limitations: M5Stack contacts are shown in an enlarged physical socket mating-face inset, with the housing rear-label side up. J1 numbering follows each linked source schematic, not assumed generic Grove color numbering. Relay J2 follows the printed COM/NO/NC terminal order.
M5Stack U021 schematic download filename says U201; the title, source product page and circuit identify the U021 light unit.

MIKROE reference carriers retain source DXF header coordinates but select 1 mm drills and 1.8 mm copper. They omit the full production notch/silkscreen/courtyard. NC pins remain exposed and typed no_connect.

BUZZ v100 CAD archive contains DXF only. Button R v100 and Light v101 archives contain DXF and STEP. M5Stack links point to manufacturer housing STL files. None of these external models is imported into the generated approximate WRL.
